ends.note: ends at the Ohio River bank (66 ft label at the bank)

notes: Alley printed 'CRANDALL (GILMORE) ALLEY', 25 ft. Commerce jogs at Race and again at Vine: west of Race 22 ft at y=1217; Race-Vine leg 25 ft (label at Race) at y=1258-1260; east of Vine at y=1215 (continues onto Volume 2). Picks for the Race-Vine leg use the 25 ft street line (north building line plus 12.5 ft, matching the water pipe); a later correction slip opens the strip south of it to the Cincinnati Southern depot face and labels it 60 ft near Vine, which would put the widened centreline near y=1310. The depot (correction slip) covers Race between Commerce and Front, and the Fruit Exchange Building (1923) covers Race from Front to about y=2510, so Race/Front is kept as cross on the line of the water pipe though both legs are built over. The lettering 'VOLUME' printed down the east side of Vine marks the Volume 2 boundary. Race runs off the bottom edge.
